<b>Plasmids</b> are [[Enemies (Silksong)|enemies]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. They are the [[Lifeblood#Mutation|plasmified]] form of [[Gromling]]s, displaying a potent regenerative ability.<ref>Plasmid [[Hunter's Journal (Silksong)|Hunter's Journal]] entry: <i>"Mutated young worm infected with Plasmium. The new form displays potent regenerative skill."</i></ref>

== Behaviour and Tactics ==
Plasmids remain stationary underground, partly visible. When [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] approaches or attacks them from a distance, Plasmids emerge, perform an attack, and then burrow back down. Playing the [[Needolin]] or using the [[Challenge]] ability alerts Plasmids from a greater distance than simply approaching them. While underground, they can reposition before attacking again, giving away their movement with a trail of kicked-up dust. Plasmids have two attacks:
* <b>Plasmium Spit:</b> Rears back and, after a brief build-up, spits a gob of [[Plasmium]] that travels in an arc.
* <b>Charge:</b> Moves backward, then charges toward Hornet, stopping only when it reaches a ledge, a wall, or goes past her. If the Plasmid fails to perform this attack because Hornet is far enough away or gets behind it right after it emerges, it performs Plasmium Spit instead.

Plasmids deal {{Damage|2}} with their attacks and on contact.

After a short period of not taking damage, Plasmids rapidly heal themselves at a rate of 10 health every 0.75 seconds while they are not underground. Extracting [[Plasmified Blood]] from Plasmids using the [[Needle Phial]], obtained by initiating the <i>[[Alchemist's Assistant]]</i> or <i>[[Advanced Alchemy]]</i> [[wish]]es, kills them immediately.

== Location ==
Plasmids can be found in the [[Wormways]] during [[Act 3]].

== Trivia ==
* Though Plasmids do not respond to the [[Needolin]], they "sing" on their own until alerted.
* Piercing Plasmids with the [[Needle Phial]] instantly counts as a kill for the [[Hunter's Journal (Silksong)|Hunter's Journal]], even if the extraction is interrupted by taking damage. This makes it possible to complete the entry without actually killing any Plasmids.
